proposals.rationale: Add missing definition defining applicant as the individual whose citizenship and identity is being adjudicated.
proposals.quote: The term “applicant” is used hereinafter for the individual whose citizenship and identity is being adjudicated, including for form DS-2060.

fields.summary: The term "applicant" is defined as the individual whose citizenship and identity is being adjudicated, including for form DS-2060.

proposals.quote: A material discrepancy is any name change that is not defined as immaterial in 8 FAM 403.1-5.

fields.logic_text: any name change that is not defined as immaterial in 8 FAM 403.1-5
fields.summary: A material discrepancy is defined as any name change that is not defined as immaterial in 8 FAM 403.1-5.

proposals.rationale: Add missing requirement that material discrepancies must be documented by submitting one or more qualifying documents listed in the section, grouping acceptable document types.
proposals.quote: Material discrepancies between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity must be documented by submission of one or more of the documents listed in this section (see an exception for married names in 8 FAM 403.1-4(C)).

scope_quotes: between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity

alternative_quotes: (4) Documentation demonstrating change of name by operation of state law; or
fields.choice_quote: submission of one or more of the documents listed in this section
fields.choice_text: submission of one or more of the documents listed in this section: name change orders, divorce decrees, certificates of naturalization, marriage certificates, documentation demonstrating change of name by operation of state law, or documentation of customary usage
fields.logic_text: submission of one or more of the documents listed in this section
fields.summary: Material discrepancies between the name on the application, citizenship evidence, or identity evidence must be documented by submitting one or more qualifying documents listed in this section, subject to an exception for married names.

proposals.rationale: Recover missing authority/possibility under 22 CFR 51.23(c) where evidence of identity might be required to establish the name that best identifies the applicant.
